Adjust the building profile and model parameters above. The engine evaluates 495 candidates across all strategies to find the optimal solution in real time.

Data sources: ⚡ Dashboard JS · Live  computed in your browser by a simplified surrogate engine (exhaustive grid search over 495 candidates) — these react instantly to the sliders. ⚡ Flood Loads card  the structural demand of the surrogate is the Fa selected in the Flood Loads card (ASCE 7-22 S2 hydrostatic / hydrodynamic / debris), evaluated at each hydrograph depth; df, beff and hb are read from it — the Flood Depth, Wall Length and Basement H sliders were retired. 🧬 MOGA Engine · Python  results imported from the full NSGA-II optimization run (moga_flood_preservation.py, 20 seeds, embedded in this file on 2026-08-19) — these are static and do not react to the sliders.

How to Use

  1. Adjust Building Profile sliders to match your building and flood scenario.
  2. Tune Model Parameters for sensitivity analysis.
  3. Toggle Earth Pressure and Out-of-Plane checks on/off.
  4. The engine evaluates 495 candidates (3 strategies × 15 PH × 11 VIF) and shows the optimal result.
  5. Check the badge on each card: ⚡ JS · Live results are computed in the browser and react to the sliders; 🧬 MOGA · Python results come from the full offline MOGA optimization run and stay fixed.
